digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD runner capacity and workflow dispatch scheduling
propositions: Verified-lane dispatch volume dominates Actions pool saturation; tickets-branch pushes do not trigger workflows and contributed zero runs to the observed incident.
Per-run job-slot cost is 17 jobs (no mutation shards) to 24 jobs (all seven shards), with immediate fan-out peak of 13 runnable jobs after classify stage.

Incident-period burst of seven runs in five minutes created 22 waiting jobs and longest runner waits of 14m33s; current-shape burst of three concurrent full routes created 22 waiting jobs with longest wait of 3m17s.
navapbc organization operates on Free plan with 20 total and 5 macOS concurrent job limits; macOS contention is a secondary bottleneck distinct from total job queue depth.

Four mutually exclusive policy options exist: bundling preflights and capping mutation parallelism (Option A, recommended), coalescing superseded patchsets (Option B, low incremental value), moving macOS from pre-merge to branch-health (Option C, coverage tradeoff), or upgrading organization plan (Option D, recurring cost).
All measurement and evidence collection is read-only; no CI behavior has been changed and the ticket awaits operator decision before implementation.
